title: Reconcile Stable/S+/S-/O+ Definitions for V182o Re-Audit
description:
The live jnwb.addressing is_stable proxy (quality>=1.0, stable_plus aliased identically) is a much weaker test than the project's canonical 3-criterion stability pipeline (tag_stable_units.py: >=5 spikes/trial in every correct trial + firing_rate>=1Hz + (presence_ratio>=0.98 OR snr>0.75)), and the earlier V182o O+ candidate audit (examples/06_find_omission_positive_units_v182o.py) used an ad hoc Mann-Whitney+4Hz-diff test instead of the project's real candidate-labeling pipeline (run_spk_response_metrics_a8_1.py: paired Wilcoxon vs local pre-omission baseline + unpaired Mann-Whitney vs matched control, Cohen's d>0.3, BH-FDR q<0.05, S_plus/S_minus/O_plus_candidate/X_candidate priority resolution). Re-run both the canonical stability test and the canonical S+/S-/O+/X candidate pipeline on sub-V182o_ses-260629 so results are comparable to the historical grand_database_6040_units.csv methodology, and reconcile which of the previously-flagged 4 units survive under the correct definitions.

RESOLUTION (examples/07_canonical_stability_and_response_audit_v182o.py, outputs/publication_figures/canonical_audit_V182o_ses260629.csv): Canonical stability drops the qualifying pool from 165/293 (live proxy) to 62/293 (real 3-criterion test). Running the correct S+/S-/O+/X candidate pipeline with session-wide BH-FDR correction (q<0.05) across all 293 units yields ZERO O_plus_candidate or X_candidate units in this session (only S_plus_candidate=40, S_minus_candidate=87, null=166). None of the 4 previously-flagged units (243,150,102,261) are O+/X under the canonical test: 243->S_minus_candidate (canonically stable), 150->S_plus_candidate (fails canonical stability, min_trial_spikes=0), 102->null_or_unclassified (fails canonical stability), 261->S_minus_candidate (fails canonical stability). 'Prime' equivalent (X_candidate AND canonical stable) = 0 units. Sanity-checked: pre-FDR raw hits exist (~1.5% of tests) with mostly near-zero effect sizes (median d~0), so the null result after correction is expected, not a pipeline bug.
